scenarios.title: Successful execution and valid evidence
scenarios.description: A conformant completed simulated execution reconciles into verified evidence, a complete result, and trace lineage.

scenarios.title: Failed execution and failure evidence
scenarios.description: A controlled simulated failure remains failed through conformance and reconciliation and preserves skipped work.

scenarios.title: Invalid execution result rejection
scenarios.description: A non-terminal receipt is rejected by the production reconciliation boundary and cannot emit a reconciled result.

scenarios.title: Evidence mismatch detection
scenarios.description: A controlled post-reconciliation receipt mutation changes the canonical digest and no longer matches stored provenance.

scenarios.title: Complete trace continuity
scenarios.description: The reconciliation trace links request to plan, plan to result, and result to every evidence record.
